outcome.answer: The papers cover low-precision training and distributed communication, but none directly studies training across distributed private devices as a combined setting. For large-model training, AGoQ reports up to 1.34× faster training using layer-aware activation quantization and 8-bit gradient storage and communication across GPU clusters [7]; several studies examine recipes for stable FP4 training and accuracy recovery [1, 3]. For on-device distributed learning, RockNet trains across ultra-low-power devices with low communication overhead, but does not focus on low-precision numbers [8].
